named-query.name: StarredEntry.getByUser&Entry
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.user = ?1 AND s.entry = ?2

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getStarredEntriesByUser
named-query.query: SELECT s.entry FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.user = ?1 ORDER BY s.dateStarred DESC

named-query.name: StarredEntry.removeByUser
named-query.query: DELETE FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.user = ?1

named-query.name: StarredEntry.removeByEntry
named-query.query: DELETE FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.entry = ?1

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getCountStarredEntriesByUser
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(s) FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.user = ?1

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getCountByEntry
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(s) FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.entry = ?1

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getMostStarredEntryId
named-query.query: SELECT s.entry.id FROM StarredEntry s GROUP BY s.entry.id ORDER BY COUNT(s) DESC

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getTrendingEntries
named-query.query: SELECT s.entry.id, COUNT(s) FROM StarredEntry s WHERE s.entry.status = org.apache.roller.weblogger.pojos.WeblogEntry.PubStatus.PUBLISHED GROUP BY s.entry.id ORDER BY COUNT(s) DESC

named-query.name: StarredEntry.getCategoryLikeCounts
named-query.query: SELECT s.entry.category.name, COUNT(s) FROM StarredEntry s GROUP BY s.entry.category.name
